about: Obligation register built from the 17 executed documents in Project/Dataset/signed_contracts, reviewed 28 Sep 2026. Added to the dataset by this project (the README says AtliQ has no register). Status is computed against the as-of date; 'statusOverride' records waivers and supersession. 'match' tells the conflict checker what would collide with each restriction.

obligations.summary: No travel-booking software for online travel agencies in India; hotels and airlines carved out (6.2). Term to 30 Jun 2024 + 12 months.
obligations.quote: it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India

obligations.summary: Crestline's rates must stay no less favourable than those offered by AtliQ or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services; lower rates apply to Crestline retroactively. Accepted in 2024 because 'we never discount'.
obligations.quote: are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term

obligations.summary: Crestline may audit AtliQ's pricing records once a year, any lower rate given elsewhere would surface.
obligations.quote: Crestline or an independent auditor bound by confidentiality may audit Supplier's records

obligations.summary: No access to Crestline production data from outside the US without approval.
obligations.quote: shall not access Crestline production data from outside the United States without Crestline's prior written approval

obligations.summary: CGL $1M per occurrence and professional liability (E&O) $2M.
obligations.quote: professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least $2,000,000

obligations.summary: Confidentiality survives 3 years after termination; trade secrets indefinitely.
obligations.quote: survive for three (3) years following termination, and indefinitely for trade secrets

obligations.summary: Disclosure window to 21 Jan 2027; obligations last 5 years from each disclosure. Al Noor's guest and pricing know-how must not reach another hotel group.
obligations.quote: shall continue for five (5) years from the date of each disclosure

obligations.summary: PayTrack payment data stored in India only.
obligations.quote: shall ensure that such data is stored only in India

obligations.summary: 5 years after termination; indefinitely for Client Data.
obligations.quote: indefinitely in respect of Client Data

obligations.summary: 24-hour breach notice; PayTrack and its regulators may audit.
obligations.quote: permit PayTrack and its regulators to audit its compliance

obligations.summary: Mutual non-solicit of staff engaged in the Services, term + 12 months.
obligations.quote: during the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter

obligations.summary: Mutual confidentiality 3 years after termination; mutual non-solicit 6 months.
obligations.quote: shall survive for three (3) years after termination

obligations.summary: Deliverables vest in Acme on payment, but the freelancer who built the dashboards (Rohan Iyer) kept ownership of his work (OB-24), so AtliQ may not hold what it assigned.
obligations.quote: shall vest in the Client

obligations.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates (so AtliQ Inc too) may not provide data analytics, AI or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC, hotels, resorts, serviced apartments, or anyone providing distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to them, until 18 months after the term (14 Sep 2029). Applies wherever the work is done. Only the Seaside Hotels SOW was waived (OB-21).
obligations.quote: neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC

obligations.summary: Any GCC hospitality engagement needs its own written consent from Al Noor; a waiver is limited to its express terms.
obligations.quote: Any such waiver shall be limited to its express terms.

obligations.summary: Mutual non-solicit of staff directly involved, term + 12 months.
obligations.quote: During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter

obligations.summary: No subcontracting any part of the Services without Al Noor's written consent.
obligations.quote: shall not subcontract any part of the Services without the Client's prior written consent

obligations.summary: Guest Data stays in the UAE; India access only remotely. Professional indemnity cover of $500k.
obligations.quote: Any Guest Data accessed from India shall be accessed remotely from UAE-hosted environments only.

obligations.summary: Delay damages capped at 10% of total fees, approved as a strategic exception for Al Noor only, 'not our new standard'.
obligations.quote: shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the total Fees payable under this Agreement

obligations.summary: Consent for the Seaside Hotels SOW only. Expressly excludes renewals, any other Hospitality Business in Oman or the GCC, and any Affiliate. Staff who saw Al Noor data may not see Seaside data.
obligations.quote: It does not extend to (a) any other services provided to Seaside, including any extension, renewal, change order or follow-on statement of work, unless separately consented to in writing by the Client; (b) any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier.

obligations.summary: Every Sunrise SOW incorporates the MSA's terms (1x cap, mutual indemnity, 30-day payment, Pune arbitration).
obligations.quote: Each SOW shall be a separate contract incorporating the terms of this Agreement.

obligations.summary: Confidentiality 3 years after termination; non-solicit for each SOW term + 6 months.
obligations.quote: This obligation shall survive for three (3) years after termination.

obligations.quote: Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
